pages.text: Build the pattern around the altar, at the altar's own height. Then right-click the altar while holding the ritual's $(l)offering$().$(br2)If the pattern is incomplete, $(l)smoke$() rises where something is missing. Candles must be $(l)lit$(); they go out when a ritual completes.
pages.title: Rituals

pages.text: Right-click the altar with an empty hand to recall the rituals you know.
